title: Palermo Stone shows pre-dynastic Egyptian civilization

tellings.quote: And I believe it's the Polarmo stone that shows that there's Egyptian civilization that dates back far before the dynastic period.

plain: A pyramid researcher named Geoffrey Drumm says the Palermo Stone, an ancient Egyptian stone slab carved with records of early kings, shows that Egyptian civilisation goes back far before the age of the pharaohs. He hedges a little, saying "I believe it's the Polarmo stone," and offers it from his own reading without naming a source. If he is right, Egypt's civilisation would be much older than the usual history allows.
